exclusions_stated_by_publisher: No redaction or exclusion is stated: the layer's description and copyrightText are empty and no field carries a description other than case_number's nameOrTitle tag (evidence/doc_00.json); the registry's redactions field is empty (evidence/registry_row.json).

Location fields are published as anonymized: field aliases 'Anonymized Address', 'Anonymized Latitude', 'Anonymized Longitude' (evidence/doc_00.json fields case_address_anonymized, case_latitude_anonymized, case_longitude_anonymized). Addresses are shown as hundred blocks, e.g. '6XX CHERRY ST' (evidence/raw_cache_profile.json examples). The anonymization method is not documented.
known_differences_from_fetch_script: Rape cannot be reconciled: no crime_code 11A, 11B, 11C or 11D (and no 36A/36B) appears in the pull, and no nibrs_offense value names a sex offense (evidence/raw_cache_profile.json crime_code and nibrs_offense distinct lists). Rape is left unmapped; official rape is 145, 107, 100 for 2023-2025 (evidence/official_totals.csv). Sex offenses may sit inside crime_code '999' / nibrs_offense 'ALL OTHER' (36,051 rows, crime_category and offense_category 'Other'; query of raw_cache), but nothing in the evidence says so.

The layer holds 2023-2025 only: reported_date runs 1672552800000 (2023-01-01 06:00 UTC) to 1767160800000 (2025-12-31 06:00 UTC) (evidence/raw_cache_profile.json). 2018-2022 official totals (evidence/official_totals.csv) have no feed rows to reconcile against.
Dates are the report date; no occurrence date is published (evidence/doc_00.json fields). Offenses that occurred in one year and were reported in the next are counted in the report year.

Unit: rows repeat within a case and NIBRS code. 100,650 rows carry 92,122 distinct case_number|crime_code pairs; the 6,439 repeating pairs have the same reported_date and point in every case (query of raw_cache), and sampled 13A repeats are identical in every published field except OBJECTID/GlobalID (query of raw_cache: 2023-00006651, 2024-00018063, 2025-00019236). The repeats are likely per victim or offender, but the layer does not say. Dedupe keeps one row per case and code. SRS and NIBRS-SRS-equivalent counts are per victim for murder and aggravated assault, so dedupe can undercount those: aggravated assault 1,260/1,239/1,167 rows vs 1,181/1,141/1,072 deduped vs official 1,138/1,198/1,123 for 2023-2025 (query of raw_cache; evidence/official_totals.csv).

No hierarchy rule: a case with several mapped codes (e.g. 220 and 23x) counts once per code. Larceny for 2023-2025 is 4,915/4,604/4,386 case|code pairs in 4,904/4,589/4,368 distinct cases (query of raw_cache).
Left out: 09B negligent manslaughter (15 rows), 13B simple assault (7,273), 13C intimidation (4,023) (evidence/raw_cache_profile.json crime_code). No 09C rows are present.

Deduped pull vs official totals by reported year 2023/2024/2025 (query of raw_cache; evidence/official_totals.csv): murder 11/9/4 vs 9/9/3; robbery 200/161/144 vs 190/157/138; aggravated assault 1,181/1,141/1,072 vs 1,138/1,198/1,123; burglary 1,237/1,043/866 vs 946/968/823; larceny 4,915/4,604/4,386 vs 4,762/4,482/4,240; motor vehicle theft 1,356/1,119/944 vs 1,314/1,092/929. Burglary runs 31% above official in 2023 (1,237 vs 946), with no published reason.

Points are anonymized and concentrate at a few locations: the most frequent point, '2X E 1ST ST' (41.586439, -93.614865), carries 1,693 rows and '51XX SE 14TH ST' 1,548 (query of raw_cache). 10,802 distinct anonymized addresses map to 8,177 distinct points (query of raw_cache).
notes: Source is the Des Moines Police Department ArcGIS layer pd_crime_layer (view PSDP_Crime_Layer_View/FeatureServer/0), ORI IA0770300, scope the City of Des Moines, 19:municipal:place:1921000 (evidence/registry_row.json; evidence/scope_candidates.csv; evidence/doc_00.json name). Endpoint, portal_type and where are the registry's (evidence/registry_row.json api_endpoint, portal_type, probe_where); the archive was pulled with that where (packet.json case_text), so a live pull returns the same rows. page_size 2000 is the layer's maxRecordCount (evidence/doc_00.json). Dates: date_field reported_date, the report date; the layer publishes no occurrence date (evidence/doc_00.json fields). reported_date is epoch ms with dateFieldsTimeReference UTC (evidence/doc_00.json); every value is local midnight stored as 05:00 UTC (68,574 rows) or 06:00 UTC (32,076 rows) (query of raw_cache: reported_date % 86400000 = 18000000 or 21600000), so the UTC year equals the local year and no year_field is needed. Rows per reported year: 33,734 / 33,655 / 33,261 for 2023/2024/2025, none earlier (query of raw_cache). count_unit is offense: each row carries one NIBRS crime_code within a case_number (77,928 distinct cases in 100,650 rows; evidence/raw_cache_profile.json). id is case_number|crime_code with dedupe, keeping the first row per case and code; OBJECTID and GlobalID are unique per row and would keep the repeats (see known differences). When a case carries several mapped codes, each code is kept as its own offense. Offense rules match crime_code exactly (case-sensitive), and every mapped code is present in the pull (evidence/raw_cache_profile.json crime_code: 09A 24; 120 506; 13A 3,666; 220 3,161; 23A 127, 23B 38, 23C 3,829, 23D 2,192, 23E 22, 23F 2,772, 23G 770, 23H 4,214; 240 3,425); each code's count equals its nibrs_offense label count (e.g. 09A 24 = 'Murder/Nonnegligent Manslaughter' 24; 13A 3,666 = 'Aggravated Assault' 3,666). Rape is unmapped because no 11A/11B/11C code is present. Coordinates are case_latitude_anonymized / case_longitude_anonymized, which equal the feature geometry (__arcgis_latitude/__arcgis_longitude) on all 100,650 rows (query of raw_cache: 0 rows differ by more than 1e-6). The publisher labels them anonymized and shows addresses as hundred blocks; the offset method is not stated. All rows have coordinates, none at 0, and all lie in 41.36-41.85 N, 93.43-94.16 W, inside Iowa (evidence/raw_cache_profile.json min/max; query of raw_cache). Points outside the city are left to the scope filter; 56 mapped rows have police_district 'na' (query of raw_cache). Deduped counts per reported year 2023/2024/2025: murder 11/9/4; robbery 200/161/144; aggravated assault 1,181/1,141/1,072; burglary 1,237/1,043/866; larceny 4,915/4,604/4,386; motor vehicle theft 1,356/1,119/944 (query of raw_cache, count distinct case_number||'|'||crime_code by year of reported_date).
